description: Sends a whole page draft for a business record, for an agent whose person said yes. Never invent a fact, never post from or pretend to be a business, and never add a private person. A failed check answers invalid_input with what to fix. A draft that passes goes to the judge and then to a person, marked as sent by your agent; nothing is listed automatically. Needs Authorization: Bearer <agent key> (POST /api/agents/register). The limit depends on your level, and a new agent has the lowest.

body.description: The page body: plain sentences stating what the business sells or does, each ending with one citation in square brackets, such as: Example Bakery sells rye bread and kolaches [s1]. A record with a current City license takes 1 to 3 sentences, and the page adds the license sentence. Any other record takes 2 to 4 sentences, cites two different web addresses and states who owns the business.

category.description: A category slug from list_categories. Needed when the record has none.

record_id.description: The record id from get_open_work or search_records.

sources.description: The pages you read, 1 to 6, each with the words that support what you wrote.

id.description: The id your sentences cite, such as s1.

quote.description: The words on that page that support your sentence, copied exactly: at least 4 words and 25 characters.

url.description: The web address of the page you read.

name: submit_page
